en: Friday seems good to me, let's do it.
es: El viernes me parece bien, hagámoslo.

en: It's all the same to Tomás whether we eat here or there.
es: A Tomás le da igual comer aquí o allá.
why: Here or there makes no difference.

en: Does it seem fine to you all if we start now?
why: Asking for approval is parecer bien.

en: That plan seems good to Rosa.
es: A Rosa le parece bien ese plan.
why: Approving a plan is parecer bien.
